name: Des Moines Art Center Teen Arts Academy and Teen Clay Academy
what_you_do: A nine month art program for high school students. Students meet once a week and build a portfolio. You can apply for the Arts Academy, the Clay Academy, or both.
who_can_apply: Students currently enrolled in high school. The application asks for your grade, 9th through 12th.
pay_detail: Tuition is not listed on the program page. Ask the Studio Arts Department. The Art Center offers help with travel costs for students who need help getting to class.
duration: Nine months, once a week, following the school calendar.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year closed Thursday, October 15, 2026, the day Teen Academy classes began. The program starts each fall. The 2027-28 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application on the program page. It has seven essay questions (six required). You also upload a portfolio of five pieces, and all five are required. Email studioclasses@desmoinesartcenter.org with questions.
notes: Not a job: this is a class and portfolio program. The 2027-28 dates are not posted yet, so the dates shown are from the 2026-27 cycle. Ask the Studio Arts Department when the next application opens.
